test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.**

I cannot take up any new assignment as __I have my hands full__.
solution:
The correct answer is **'am very busy'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the idiom** 'have my hands full'** is **'to be so busy that you do not have time to do anything else'**
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• I'd love to help but I've got **my hands full** organizing the school play.
 
 
 
• So the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• मुहावरे का अर्थ 'have my hands full' है 'इतना व्यस्त होना कि आपके पास कुछ और करने का समय न हो'
 
• आइए एक उदाहरण देखते हैं-
 
 
• I'd love to help but I've got **my hands full **organizing the school play.
 
 
 
• तो सही उत्तर** विकल्प 1 है।**

10b:T8ba,

The correct answer is **'at the height of activity'**
